name: Merapi Run 2026
short_description: A half-marathon and multi-distance race held on 9 August 2026 in Kaliurang, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, featuring 493m of elevation gain on the 21.1km course.
ai_summary: Merapi Run 2026 is a half-marathon event taking place on 9 August 2026 at Griya Persada Convention Hotel & Resort in Kaliurang, Yogyakarta, Indonesia. Runners can choose from four distances: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, or 3km, with the half-marathon course featuring 493m of elevation gain. Registration opens on 6 May 2026, with prices ranging from Rp 200.000 to Rp 500.000 depending on the distance chosen.

faqs.question: When is the Merapi Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The Merapi Run 2026 is scheduled to take place on 9 August 2026. The event will be held at Griya Persada Convention Hotel & Resort in Kaliurang, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, offering runners a mid-year race option with multiple distance categories to choose from.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at Merapi Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Merapi Run 2026 offers four distance options for participants: a 21.1km half-marathon, a 10km race, a 5km race, and a shorter 3km race. This variety allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to participate in the event.

faqs.question: How much elevation gain is there in the half-marathon?
faqs.answer: The half-marathon distance (21.1km) at Merapi Run 2026 includes a total elevation gain of 493 meters. This makes the course notably hilly compared to flat road races, so runners should prepare for climbing sections throughout the route in Kaliurang.

faqs.question: When does registration open and what does it cost?
faqs.answer: Registration for Merapi Run 2026 opens on 6 May 2026. Entry fees range from Rp 200.000 to Rp 500.000, with the exact price depending on which of the four distance categories a participant chooses to enter.
